easyPrerequisites:
Siren of the Silent Song doesn't have summoning sickness and has a +1/+1 counter on it.
Tidewater Minion is exiled by Agatha's Soul Cauldron.
description:
Activate Siren of the Silent Song using Tidewater Minion's ability by tapping it, untapping Siren of the Silent Song
Siren of the Silent Song triggers, causing each opponent to discard and mill a card.
Repeat.
